name: Contacts
description: macOS Contacts in Asyar: search contacts and dial them through your iPhone.
author: Kai Osthoff

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Enter key
preferences.description: What Enter does on the highlighted contact.

preferences.name: countryCode
preferences.title: Country code
preferences.description: Dialing prefix for nationally stored numbers, e.g. +49. "auto" takes the region from your macOS settings. Leave it empty to dial numbers exactly as stored.

preferences.name: preferredLabels
preferences.title: Preferred numbers
preferences.description: Comma-separated label order deciding which number is dialled first.
preferences.default: iPhone, Mobile, Mobil, Handy, Home, Privat, Work, Arbeit

preferences.name: showAvatars
preferences.title: Show contact photos
preferences.description: Loads the photo of the highlighted contact. Unchecked, rows show initials only.

preferences.name: includeOrganizations
preferences.title: Include companies
preferences.description: Also lists entries without a person's name, i.e. company-only records.

preferences.name: backgroundRefresh
preferences.title: Refresh in the background
preferences.description: Refreshes the contact cache every 30 minutes so the first match is instant. Only starts once the contacts have been loaded manually.

commands.name: Search Contacts
commands.description: Search macOS Contacts and call, FaceTime or message them via your iPhone.

commands.name: Refresh address book cache
commands.description: Refresh the cached contact index in the background.

actions.title: Reload contacts
actions.description: Reads the macOS address book again and discards the cache.
